configurationItems.name: endpoints
configurationItems.description: Define the Elasticsearch endpoints

configurationItems.name: keys
configurationItems.description: Set the Elasticsearch api keys for each endpoint. Note: Use api key or basic auth, but not both.

configurationItems.name: users
configurationItems.description: Set the Elasticsearch users for each endpoint. Note: Use api key or basic auth, but not both.

configurationItems.name: passwords
configurationItems.description: Set the Elasticsearch passwords for each endpoint. Note: Use api key or basic auth, but not both.

configurationItems.name: kibana
configurationItems.description: Shared Kibana base URL for query, dashboard and document links, including any reverse-proxy or /s/<space> path. Leave empty to disable all Kibana links; omit app paths, query and fragment.

configurationItems.name: dashboard
configurationItems.description: Optional Kibana dashboard ID for the report query link. Leave empty to open Discover with the observable query and selected timestamp order.

configurationItems.name: index
configurationItems.description: Define the Elasticsearch indices to use

configurationItems.name: size
configurationItems.description: Define the number of hits per index to return

configurationItems.name: verifyssl
configurationItems.description: Verify SSL certificate

configurationItems.name: cert_path
configurationItems.description: Path to the CA on the system used to check server certificate

configurationItems.name: ip_fields
configurationItems.description: Fields to query for IP observables.

configurationItems.name: domain_fields
configurationItems.description: Fields to query for domain observables; also used for FQDN observables.

configurationItems.name: url_fields
configurationItems.description: Fields to query for URL observables; also used for FQDN observables.

configurationItems.name: hostname_fields
configurationItems.description: Fields to query for hostname observables.

configurationItems.name: email_fields
configurationItems.description: Fields to query for mail/email-address observables.

configurationItems.name: filename_fields
configurationItems.description: Fields to query for filename observables, together with process_args_fields.

configurationItems.name: hash_fields
configurationItems.description: Fields to query for hash observables.

configurationItems.name: username_fields
configurationItems.description: Fields to query for username observables.

configurationItems.name: email_subject_fields
configurationItems.description: Fields to query for mail-subject observables.

configurationItems.name: user_agent_fields
configurationItems.description: Fields to query for user-agent observables.

configurationItems.name: process_args_fields
configurationItems.description: Additional process argument fields to query for filename observables.

configurationItems.name: lookback_days
configurationItems.description: Days back from job start; 0 searches all retained data.

configurationItems.name: pit_threshold
configurationItems.description: Automatic ordinary-search threshold and maximum PIT page size, from 1 to 10000. Runtime pressure can reduce page size.

configurationItems.name: pit_keep_alive
configurationItems.description: PIT retention between requests, e.g. 10m; cover processing, retry and backoff delays. Not a query timeout.

configurationItems.name: track_total_hits
configurationItems.description: Accurate-count threshold: integer, true for exact, false to disable.

configurationItems.name: field_retrieval
configurationItems.description: source, fields, or docvalues; see module documentation.

configurationItems.name: include_report_fields
configurationItems.description: Return existing report fields as well as query fields and timestamp.

configurationItems.name: return_fields
configurationItems.description: Additional returned field names, object roots or patterns. Requested data_stream and observer fields enable the supported event tags; other fields only add report data.

configurationItems.name: search_concurrency
configurationItems.description: Maximum concurrent index-pattern searches per endpoint, from 1 to 8. Runtime pressure can reduce concurrency.

configurationItems.name: max_concurrent_shard_requests
configurationItems.description: Maximum concurrent shard requests per node for each search. Runtime pressure can reduce this ceiling.

configurationItems.name: sort_order
configurationItems.description: Timestamp search order: desc retrieves newest first (default); asc retrieves oldest first. Missing timestamps are last.

configurationItems.name: search_timeout
configurationItems.description: Server search timeout for each page/sub-search.

configurationItems.name: request_timeout
configurationItems.description: Client request timeout in seconds; must exceed search_timeout.

configurationItems.name: max_retries
configurationItems.description: Maximum retries per HTTP request, including timeouts. 0 disables retries; 3 allows up to 4 total attempts.

configurationItems.name: mark_sighted_on_hits
configurationItems.description: Mark the matching observable in the originating TheHive 4 case sighted when valid hits are returned. Requires TheHive credentials and the dynamic case context in input.message; ambiguous matches are not updated.

configurationItems.name: thehive_url
configurationItems.description: TheHive deployment URL for observable sighting; configuration only. Native tag operations do not use it.

configurationItems.name: thehive_api_key
configurationItems.description: TheHive API key with manageObservable permission for sighting. Native tag operations need no API key. Keep in Cortex configuration; never supply in job parameters.

configurationItems.name: thehive_verifyssl
configurationItems.description: Verify the TheHive server TLS certificate.

configurationItems.name: thehive_cert_path
configurationItems.description: Optional CA certificate path for TheHive; otherwise use the system trust store.

configurationItems.name: add_tags_to_observable
configurationItems.description: Request AddTagToArtifact operations for the unique report tags. TheHive applies them to the originating observable when processing the report; no TheHive API credentials or case lookup are needed for tagging. IP classification tags can be requested without search hits.

configurationItems.name: data_view_id
configurationItems.description: Kibana data-view ID used for document links. This is the saved data-view ID, not the analyzer's matched index patterns.

configurationItems.name: debug
configurationItems.description: Include full.debug with the submitted job configuration (credentials redacted), TheHive URL and effective organisation. False omits the debug field entirely.
